svg.aria-label: Delivery: business discovery and direction, design and prototyping, documentation and approval (human-led); implementation (AI-assisted); review and quality assurance (human-led); controlled release and operations (governed). Human approval gates after design; after documentation, for architecture, security and privacy; and before release, for operational acceptance.
